name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Customizable Cosmetic Set
summary:
This set contains the following items usable in ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE:

Aircraft Skins
- F-4E Mobius Squadron 25th Anniversary Skin
A Mobius Squadron 25th anniversary skin for the F-4E Phantom II
- F/A-18C Team Zvezda Skin
A Team Zvezda skin for the F/A-18C Hornet

- Online Lobby Avatar Outfit: Tasha
An outfit inspired by Tasha, the pilot of Joker Flight's third aircraft in Campaign Mode.
*Exclusive item for the online mode ACE COMBAT ONLINE.

- Aircraft Upgrade Part Missile Smoke [Scarlet]
An upgrade part that changes missile smoke color to Scarlet when equipped to an aircraft.
*Exclusive item for the online mode ACE COMBAT ONLINE.

*The Deluxe Edition also includes the Customizable Cosmetic Set. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.
